patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I know how this sounds. I know what my chart says. It's my usual crisis, it's in my back and my legs, and the only thing that has ever touched it is exactly what I'm about to ask you for.
presentation.triageNote: 26-year-old male with sickle cell disease, eight hours of his typical vaso-occlusive pain in the back and legs, unrelieved by home medication.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because pain rated 10 out of 10 with failure of home medication in sickle cell disease requires rapid analgesia and assessment for complications.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has a typical severe vaso-occlusive pain episode involving the back and legs.
clinical.acuityReason: The familiar pattern is reassuring against a new diagnosis, but extreme pain and the risk of acute chest syndrome or infection require rapid equitable treatment.
expectedResources: CBC, reticulocyte, metabolic, and hemolysis testing as indicated
Screening for acute chest, infection, and other complications
keyFindings: Eight hours of typical back and leg pain
redFlags: Risk of occult sickle cell complication
teachingPoints: Stigmatizing labels contribute to dangerous undertreatment and should not replace assessment.
Chest pain, fever, hypoxemia, neurologic symptoms, priapism, or splenic findings require focused escalation.

possibleDiagnoses: Acute chest syndrome if respiratory findings emerge
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Rapid protocolized analgesia and complication screening would guide discharge after control or admission for persistent pain or complications.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a black 26-year-old man in a tracksuit, sitting rigidly on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting very still and guarded, hands pressed against his lower back
aiImageGeneration.expression: drawn and exhausted with pain, tightly controlled
signs: yellowish tinge to the whites of the eyes
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: in severe genuine pain and holding himself together
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a black 26-year-old man in a tracksuit, sitting rigidly on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting very still and guarded, hands pressed against his lower back. Expression: drawn and exhausted with pain, tightly controlled. Clearly visible: rigid guarded posture; sweat on the temples; yellowish tinge to the whites of the eyes. Overall: in severe genuine pain and holding himself together. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
